orig_finding: S12a-010 ¦ missed ¦ design/spec.md:9725 ¦ law ¦ deviation ¦ False ¦ D-269 (Position, third bullet: 'A change issued during a frame's wait lands at the next frame top, at most one budget h/p later'). That entry covers only a change issued during the wait, not one issued while a frame runs. ¦ Delay is at most one frame budget, dt_frame/p ¦ A change issued while a frame runs or waits is observed at the next frame top. While the run keeps pace, that is at most about one frame budget (`Δt_frame/p`, the frame period over the pace) later. Otherwise it is once the running frame ends ([D-269][d-269]). ¦ src/sim.jl:2100-2109: the stop word and the pause flag are read only at frame top, before the explicit yield and the pacer's wait, and run_frame! is never interrupted. A change issued while a frame computes is therefore seen only when that frame ends. With pace Inf, the default (src/control.jl:74), the budget Δt_frame/p is 0 but the delay is the frame's compute time, and a late (overrunning) frame delays it past the budget. Probe P6 (probe.jl:70-77): in a paced run with a 0.5 s budget, the time from stop! to run!'s return was 0.208 s, so the bound holds while the run keeps pace. ¦
